basic_details.job_title: TEAM Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 8 Multi Purpose Worker, Dietician and More Posts
basic_details.post_name: PG Qualified AYUSH Doctor, AYUSH Medical Officer, Dietician and 3 more
basic_details.short_information: Telangana Employment Assistance Mission (TEAM), Yadadri Bhuvanagiri District has invited applications for 8 posts in 6 roles. The posts include PG Qualified AYUSH Doctor, AYUSH Medical Officer, Dietician, Psycho Social Counsellor and 2 more. Applications are to be sent offline and must reach the organisation by 4 November 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Cash only; online payment is not accepted.

qualification.education_qualification: 7th class to PG: PG/degree in Ayurveda, Unani, Homeopathy or Naturopathy; BSc Nutrition; MSW; degree in Naturopathy or Naturopathy with Diploma in Yogic Science; 7th class pass

vacancy_details.details: Qualification required: PG degree in Ayurveda, Unani, Homeopathy or Naturopathy (minimum 3 years regular study). Age limit: 18 to 44 years. Pay: Rs. 60,000 per month. Qualification required: Degree in Ayurveda, Unani, Homeopathy or Naturopathy (4.5 years regular study + 1 year internship). Age limit: 18 to 44 years. Pay: Rs. 40,000 per month. Qualification required: BSc Nutrition. Age limit: 18 to 44 years. Pay: Rs. 20,000 per month. Qualification required: Master of Social Work (MSW). Age limit: 18 to 44 years. Pay: Rs. 500 per session (on call, minimum 200 visits per year). Qualification required: Degree in Naturopathy (4.5 years + 1 year internship), or Naturopathy and Diploma in Yogic Science. Age limit: 18 to 44 years. Pay: Rs. 28,000 per month. Qualification required: 7th class pass;

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 15,000 to Rs. 60,000, depending on the post

how_to_apply: Download the application form from https://yadadri.telangana.gov.in/.
Attach self-attested copies of certificates for the educational qualifications, caste certificate, Aadhaar card and bonafide certificates from class 1 to 7.
Submit the application at the TEAM office, Room No. F8, ground floor, Collectorate, District Employment Office, Yadadri Bhuvanagiri, by 5 PM on any working day from 28-10-2026 to 04-11-2026.
Pay the Rs. 100 application fee in cash only.
important_instructions: Applications received after the deadline will not be accepted. Vacancy details are available in Telugu and English on the website.

content_sections.heading: TEAM Job Description
content_sections.text: PG Qualified AYUSH Doctor Deliver specialized Ayurvedic, Unani, or Homeopathic medical care and treatment requiring postgraduate expertise. AYUSH Medical Officer Provide general Ayurveda, Unani, or Homeopathic healthcare services and medical examinations to beneficiaries. Dietitian Manage nutritional planning, dietary assessments, and nutritional counseling for targeted missions and healthcare programs. Social Counselor Conduct counseling sessions, psycho-social assessments, and manage mental health support cases on call and during designated visits. Yoga Professional Demonstrate and instruct yoga exercises, therapeutic postures, and wellness modules for health promotion. Multi Purpose Worker Perform assigned multipurpose field and operational duties, utilizing motorcycle driving skills as required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for TEAM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 4 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in TEAM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 8 vacancies: 1 PG Qualified AYUSH Doctor, 2 AYUSH Medical Officer, 1 Dietician, 1 Psycho Social Counsellor, 1 Yoga Professional, 2 Multi Purpose Worker.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for TEAM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Website https://yadadri.telangana.gov.in/) and send it to TEAM Office, Room No. F8, ground floor, Collectorate, District Employment Office, Yadadri Bhuvanagiri, by by post or by hand; the notice also says online submission is accepted, to reach by 4 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: All Candidates: Rs. 100.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 44 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 60,000 per month for PG Qualified AYUSH Doctor, Rs. 40,000 per month for AYUSH Medical Officer, Rs. 20,000 per month for Dietician, Rs. 500 per session (on call, minimum 200 visits per year) for Psycho Social Counsellor, Rs. 28,000 per month for Yoga Professional.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: 7th class to PG: PG/degree in Ayurveda, Unani, Homeopathy or Naturopathy; BSc Nutrition; MSW; degree in Naturopathy or Naturopathy with Diploma in Yogic Science; 7th class pass. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Multi Purpose Worker must be able to ride a cycle or motorcycle.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates with less than the prescribed qualification.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Merit. Roster. Selection is based on merit and roster.
